## CLI options

| Script | Option count | Description |
|---|---:|---|
| `scripts/generate_report.py` | 9 | Render a Mumei demo result. |
| `scripts/run_specimen_audits.py` | 10 | Run `mumei-agent audit` over every specimen and score it against DEFECTS.json. |
| `scripts/extract_adjudication_worksheet.py` | 4 | Extract unreviewed and stale specimen-audit findings into a human-review worksheet. |
| `scripts/run_baselines.py` | 13 | Run off-the-shelf static analyzers over the specimens and score them like the audit. |
| `scripts/run_llm_only.py` | 8 | Ask an LLM alone (no Mumei) to review the specimens, and score it like the baselines. |
| `scripts/compare_arms.py` | 2 | Compare three ways of reviewing the specimen corpus side by side. |
| `scripts/run_contract_bench.py` | 10 | Contract benchmark: can a defect be refuted and its fix be proven against one fixed contract? |
| `scripts/recheck_lean_dual_checks.py` | 2 | Re-run committed contract-bench proof certificates through the current Lean dual checker. After updating the default results file, run `python3 scripts/run_contract_bench.py --render-only` to regenerate the Markdown summary. |
| `scripts/run_machine_tv_bench.py` | 5 | Measure native-object acceptance on the paired source-contract benchmark ports. |
| `scripts/compare_machine_tv_runs.py` | 1 | Compare two machine-TV benchmark reports by case, variant, stage, and diagnostic. |
| `scripts/check_machine_tv_stability.py` | 4 | Run a focused machine-TV benchmark matrix twice and compare repeat stability. |
| `scripts/run_native_replay.py` | 4 | Replay concrete inputs on the native code and on the .mm ports of the contract benchmark. |
| `scripts/run_port_divergence.py` | 4 | Replay reference counterexamples on the bench's accepted buggy LLM ports. |
| `scripts/run_port_prompt_ablation.py` | 8 | Screen candidate port-generation prompts without touching canonical benchmark artifacts. |
| `scripts/run_mutation_control.py` | 6 | Mutation control for the contract benchmark: does each contract reject small changes to the fixed port? |
| `scripts/run_regression_gate.py` | 1 | Regression gate: once a contract is pinned, does a later change that breaks it get blocked? |
| `scripts/record_scenario.py` | 2 | Finite record-operation checks and intentionally broken host variants. |
| `scripts/record_model_evidence.py` | 2 | Collect independent Lean model evidence; never promote a Python operation. |
| `scripts/check_specimens.py` | 2 | Validate specimen directories. |
| `scripts/check_evidence_regressions.py` | 1 | Exercise an evidence reader on isolated, explicitly synthetic snapshots. |
| `scripts/check_adversarial_port_corpus.py` | 3 | Check the pinned adversarial intent-fidelity corpus offline. The corpus in proofs/adversarial/ is deliberately static: it does not call an LLM or Mumei. It pins hostile generated-contract and body-port shapes to the structured warnings produced by run_port_divergence.py, so detector regressions are visible in CI before another false-acceptance measurement is interpreted. |
| `scripts/check_fixed_alarm_regression.py` | 4 | Regression gate for false alarms on fixed specimen variants. This is an offline gate over the committed no-LLM `audit/coverage.json` artifacts. It does not rerun `mumei-agent audit`; it prevents the recorded fixed-variant alarm count from silently moving upward and keeps unreviewed fixed-variant findings visible as adjudication debt. The legacy all-kind count is retained for compatibility. Only `verification_violations` are gated as code evidence; every other raw finding kind is counted and budgeted by kind without assigning those kinds one shared semantic. |
| `scripts/report_output_equivalence_coverage.py` | 3 | Report output-equivalence oracle coverage in the recorded benchmark artifact. |
| `scripts/review_charter_baseline.py` | 2 | Publish the reviewed Charter inputs and their Git diff, not an approval verdict. |
| `scripts/build_ci_evidence_pack.py` | 5 | Build the deterministic CI audit evidence-pack reference artifact. The pack uses the upstream audit CLI contract for SARIF, baselines, and fail-on policy. SARIF is emitted only by `mumei-agent audit`; the demo never fabricates it, and baseline artifacts are CI policy rather than evidence. |
| `scripts/verify_ci_evidence_pack.py` | 2 | Verify a copied or downloaded CI audit evidence pack. The default mode is structural and hash verification only. It does not claim that proof certificates were independently rechecked unless `--mumei-bin` and `--reference-contract` are supplied and `mumei verify-cert --strict` exits successfully. |
| `scripts/check_verify_distribution_reference.py` | 5 | Validate the native-first verify-distribution reference fixture. The fixture source is trusted and checked into this repository. The runtime-on lane is explicit validation of that fixture only; this script is not a generic runner for untrusted distribution artifacts. Its trusted-build-id file is a simulated producer channel: consumer invocations read it back rather than reusing the producer-side hash variable. |
| `dashboard/cli_report.py` | 1 | Render a Mumei verification report. |

### `scripts/run_contract_bench.py`

Contract benchmark: can a defect be refuted and its fix be proven against one fixed contract?

| Option | Value | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--arm` | `{mumei, llm, mumei-llm, llm-contract}` | no | — | arm to run (repeatable) |
| `--only` | `<ONLY>` | no | — | limit to these defect ids |
| `--runs` | `<RUNS>` | no | `1` | runs per LLM arm (seed = run number) |
| `--jobs` | `<JOBS>` | no | `4` | cases run in parallel |

### `scripts/check_fixed_alarm_regression.py`

Regression gate for false alarms on fixed specimen variants. This is an offline gate over the committed no-LLM `audit/coverage.json` artifacts. It does not rerun `mumei-agent audit`; it prevents the recorded fixed-variant alarm count from silently moving upward and keeps unreviewed fixed-variant findings visible as adjudication debt. The legacy all-kind count is retained for compatibility. Only `verification_violations` are gated as code evidence; every other raw finding kind is counted and budgeted by kind without assigning those kinds one shared semantic.

| Option | Value | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--root` | `<ROOT>` | no | `specimens` | — |
| `--history` | `<HISTORY>` | no | `specimens/scoreboard/history.json` | — |
| `--budget` | `<BUDGET>` | no | `specimens/scoreboard/fixed_alarm_budget.json` | — |
| `--json` | — | no | `false` | print the machine-readable evaluation |

### `scripts/check_verify_distribution_reference.py`

Validate the native-first verify-distribution reference fixture. The fixture source is trusted and checked into this repository. The runtime-on lane is explicit validation of that fixture only; this script is not a generic runner for untrusted distribution artifacts. Its trusted-build-id file is a simulated producer channel: consumer invocations read it back rather than reusing the producer-side hash variable.

## Environment variables

| Variable | Default or fallback | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `CI_FIXTURE_MODE` | Make default: `1`; direct runner: unset | Enables recorded fixtures when exactly `1`; `make demo-ci` always selects fixture mode. |
| `MUMEI_REPO` | `../mumei` sibling checkout | Read from repos.env, then the process environment; otherwise resolves the sibling checkout. |
| `MUMEI_AGENT_REPO` | `../mumei-agent` sibling checkout | Read from repos.env, then the process environment; otherwise resolves the sibling checkout. |
| `MUMEI_LEAN_REPO` | `../mumei-lean` sibling checkout | Read from repos.env, then the process environment; otherwise resolves the sibling checkout. |
| `MUMEI_BIN` | release binary, otherwise debug binary under MUMEI_REPO | Read from repos.env, then the process environment; direct audit options can override it. |
| `MUMEI_AGENT_PYTHON` | agent .venv/bin/python, otherwise python on PATH or the current interpreter | Read from repos.env, then the process environment, before choosing an available Python. |
| `LLM_BASE_URL` | `https://api.openai.com/v1` | OpenAI-compatible endpoint for `scripts/run_llm_only.py` and the LLM arms of `scripts/run_contract_bench.py` (same name as mumei-agent). |
| `LLM_MODEL` | `gpt-4o` | Model reviewed by `scripts/run_llm_only.py`; names the `llm_only/<model>.json` records that `scripts/compare_arms.py` reads. |
| `NL_REQUIREMENTS_FILE` | `spec_text.md` | Read from repos.env, then the process environment; selects the natural-language requirements input. |
